thread:
nicole: Hey team, following the `todo-app` quickstart (Go sample) and my first API call errors out. quickstart instructions were followed verbatim.

nicole: Error shown in terminal: `HTTP 402 Payment Required - workspace billing required` which is confusing because I was on the free trial page.

nicole: Go snippet: 
```
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-1", Input: "write a todo"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

devrel: 402 is our new signal when workspace has exceeded trial quota or billing not linked for org-owned workspaces. did you create the workspace with SSO?

nicole: Yes, used company SSO. I thought trials were allowed for personal dev. The Console page showed "trial active" though.

ops-bot: Workspace check -> id ws_451, owner: nicole@acme, access_policy: org_managed, trial_balance: $0.00, billing_linked: false

nicole: Ah trial_balance 0.0 explains 402. UX-wise the quickstart should warn that SSO-created workspaces require billing to hit hosted endpoints.

devrel: Agreed. Filing a tiny change to the quickstart wizard to surface workspace.billing_linked and trial_balance before running the sample. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/433

billing-bot: Automated: Workspace ws_451 requires billing to continue hosted API calls. Link billing at Console -> Billing. Temporary keys revoked after 5 minutes.

nicole: linking card fixed it, first call succeeded. Also noticed the Go SDK retries treat 402 as retryable for a couple of attempts which is noisy. Should be immediate fail.

devrel: Good catch. We'll make 402 and 401-with-billing-hint non-retryable in SDKs. Also adding better error message text: "billing required: link a payment method in Console" so it's actionable.

devex-bot: Action items: (1) Quickstart wizard will check workspace billing state and show inline guidance; (2) SDKs will mark billing-related 4xx as terminal and improve debug logs.

nicole: thanks! saved the team a few minutes and one confused intern :sweat_smile:
